name: Hermes Agent ships an official security review plugin
title: Hermes Agent ships an official security review plugin
headline: Hermes adds an official security-review plugin
lede: Hermes Agent can review a local repository for security bugs, verify candidates with parallel subagents, optionally reproduce them in a temporary copy and export findings.

effects.effect: Reports include findings the review ruled out
Review combines reachable inputs, verification and optional reproduction

possibilities.title: Open source maintainers can triage agent bug reports by requiring cross-agent agreement

with.title: OpenAI Codex Security CLI keeps climbing on GitHub
OpenAI launches Patch the Planet vulnerability coordination effort

possibilities.connection: Codex Security CLI is spreading as a way to find and fix vulnerabilities, Hermes' plugin verifies candidates with parallel subagents and can reproduce them in a temporary copy, and Patch the Planet connects agent findings with maintainers, so findings confirmed by two separate tools can be sent first.

possibilities.title: Software buyers can request reproducible vulnerability evidence before demanding supplier fixes

with.title: Run LLM-generated code in Cloudflare Sandboxes

possibilities.connection: Hermes can identify, verify and export security findings, while Cloudflare Sandboxes offers an execution environment for a custom step that runs candidate reproductions.
